name: bridgekit
description: Price-volume-mix bridge engine for configured products

scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run sitemap && VITE_PAGE_COUNTS=${VITE_PAGE_COUNTS:-1} VITE_WORKSPACES=${VITE_WORKSPACES:-1} VITE_AI_COMMENTARY=${VITE_AI_COMMENTARY:-1} vite build && node scripts/compress-wasm.mjs
scripts.build:cloudflare:free: npm run sitemap && VITE_PAGE_COUNTS=1 VITE_WORKSPACES=0 VITE_AI_COMMENTARY=0 vite build && node scripts/compress-wasm.mjs
scripts.cf:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply bridgekit --local && wrangler dev --var BETTER_AUTH_URL:http://localhost:8790
scripts.cf:deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply bridgekit --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute bridgekit --remote --command "SELECT day, path, referrer, views FROM page_views ORDER BY day DESC, views DESC LIMIT 100"
